synopsis: Komatsu’s KomVision Human Detection and Collision Mitigation system began on the PC200-11 excavator in Japan, going on sale in December 2019 [f1640, f10633]. Chapter 13 distinguishes that sales date from the announcement on 30 March 2020 [f10633]. The PC200-11 provides a restricted, low-speed automatic-braking precedent, rather than evidence of unrestricted braking capability [f10974]. Chapter 2 extends the timeline to the PC200i-12, which followed in December 2024 [f1640].

relations.note: Both date the PC200-11 system’s Japanese market introduction to December 2019.
Qualifies the PC200-11 precedent as restricted automatic braking at low speed.
Adds the announcement date, distinguishing it from the December 2019 sales start.
